subject: Future Builders Live

phase1d.reason: No primary URL in scope; no live site exists

top_findings: Missing ticket price — every revenue assumption is unvalidated without a stated price
Founder anonymity is the single largest trust barrier for parents and sponsors
Student presenter recruitment system is undefined — the emotional core of the event has no cold-start solution
Break-even math does not account for founder labor — the business model earns zero for the organizer
Premium positioning requires visually demonstrable premium quality before the first ticket is sold
verdict: Compelling concept with strong AI/robotics timing and a genuinely differentiated emotional core (kids on stage). Fundable and buildable, but requires 6 critical infrastructure pieces before Event 1 or the premium promise will underdeliver.
